_doc: MAP-15 (docs/mapping-rules.md): the pinned forms of a provider's 'no such model' answer that
carry no model-specific code and no not-found class. A provider error whose provider_code equals
`code` and whose message satisfies every text test given (`prefix`: starts with; `contains`:
includes; `suffix`: ends with, all case-sensitive) is UnsupportedModelError (unsupported_model).
Checked before the dialect's own code/type table, on every path that turns an HTTP reply into a
ProviderError. Ports carry this table as data, verbatim. A form is added only with a live receipt,
`providers` records where a form was observed; matching does not use it (code plus exact text is the test).
and is never widened beyond the answer it was captured from.

forms.contains: The supported API model names are

receipts/2026-09-24-model-not-found/zai.json: HTTP 400 {"code":"1211","message":"Unknown Model, please check the model code."}; docs.z.ai error codes: 1211 = Unknown Model

receipts/2026-09-03-zai/probe-error-model-not-found.json: HTTP 400 {"code":"1214","message":"modelCode: does not exist"} (1214 alone is 'Parameter ${field} is invalid': only the model field qualifies)
